predecessors.name: Uryankhay Republic (Republic of Uryankhay)
predecessors.text: Tuva, which became a Russian protectorate (Uryankhay Krai) in April 1914 and reaffirmed it after 1917

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: the Tuvan Autonomous Oblast within the Russian SFSR from 1 November 1944; Tuvan ASSR from 10 October 1961

ledger.x: 1921: the Tannu Tuvan People's Republic declares independence.
1926: the country becomes simply the Tuvan People's Republic and the capital Khem-Beldyr is renamed Kyzyl.

certainty.note: The frontier with Mongolia and China was undefined.
The Soviet-Tuvan border was defined in January 1923; the Mongolian line stays approximate until 1932.
The July 1932 agreement with Mongolia set the line (ratified by Mongolia only in 1944); the unratified 1940 agreement is not used.
